rows.title: Multistream Chat Widget • Rosa Chick Overlay, 3D Chat (Digital Download)
rows.description:
Multistream Chat Widget for Twitch YouTube Kick TikTok ⟢ Rosa Chick Overlay • StreamElements OBS • Alerts Avatars 3D Chat

⟢ WHAT IT IS
A StreamElements custom chat widget that merges your Twitch, YouTube, Kick and TikTok (TikFinity) chats into one cozy pastel chat box. Vertical + horizontal versions included.

⟢ FEATURES
• 6 user roles with their own colors: Admin, Moderator, VIP, Subscriber, Follower, Regular
• 5 alert types: follow · sub/membership · tip/Super Chat · cheer · raid (hosts supported too)
• 5 layout modes: bottom stack, top stack, ticker left→right, ticker right→left, fullscreen scattered
• 3D perspective: left / right / isometric with a 0–60° tilt-angle slider
• Avatars: real platform profile pics or custom uploads per role — or hide them
• Badges, pronouns, timestamps (12h/24h), large solo emotes, chat wiggle animation
• Hide messages after a time, limit visible messages, fullscreen fade for older messages
• Hide bot commands (!) and ignored users list
• Widget scale 0.5×–2×, any Google Font with weight & size controls

⟢ CUSTOMIZATION
Every color is a simple picker in StreamElements — role colors (base, gradient, glow, bubble, text), alert colors, username/message/alert fonts. No coding at all.

⟢ YOU WILL RECEIVE (instant download)
• One Click Installation easy setup
• Chat widget code file — vertical + horizontal
• Video tutorial + PDF setup guide
• OBS Studio setup tutorial

⟢ REQUIREMENTS
• Free StreamElements account (works in OBS, Streamlabs or any browser-source software via web link)
• YouTube: free YouTube Data API key (guide included)
• Kick: your channel name only
• TikTok: TikFinity desktop app (free) for live chat relay

⟢ HELP
Questions? Message us anytime — we're happy to help you get live. 💌

⟢ NOTES
• Digital product — no physical item will be shipped
• Colors may vary slightly between monitors
• For personal streaming use; please don't resell or redistribute the code
